sam: Hey folks — need a brief elevated window (45m) to pull a small sample of raw telemetry logs for a privacy QC. CHORE-4721. Will not export results, only sample and run redaction checks.

maya: Scope? which services and exact fields you need? we need clear justification for the audit record. :eyes:

sam: Scope: `telemetry-ingest` + `frontend-ingest` only. Time range: last 1h. Goal: identify any unredacted PII leaking in plain text (emails, phone numbers). We'll pull ~1k lines, run regex checks, then delete raw copy. No token or key material requested.

aj: +1 for a short window. can you run on staging first and drop the query here so we can sanity-check it?

sam: will run on staging first. Query I plan to use (staging/prod identical filter):
```
rcli logs tail --service telemetry-ingest --since 1h --filter "level:info AND message:(email OR phone)" --limit 1000 > /tmp/telemetry-sample.log
```
I will grep for email/phone patterns then run our redactor script locally (no upload).

dani: Need: explicit justification (CHORE-4721 ok), time window, exact duration, and oncall pairing. Also require session tag and full auditing. No raw file downloads outside ephemeral host.

oncall: I can pair from 14:30-15:30 PT today. I'll observe and confirm deletion after.

sam: Requested duration 45m, session_tag `priv-scan-CH4721`, will be ephemeral bastion session. I won't copy logs out; will paste sanitized summary in the ticket.

dani: Approved for 45m with oncall pairing. Conditions: 1) use break-glass ephemeral role 2) enable session recording 3) set `no-export` flag 4) annotate audit record with ticket. I'll add approval note. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Audit event created: ELEV-2423456789, approver=dani, duration=45m, tag=priv-scan-CH4721. Link: https://console.redwood/elevations/ELEV-2423456789

sam: Thanks @dani @oncall — starting staging run now, will paste sanitized query/result snippet here for sign-off before prod.

maya: Thanks. remind ops to rotate any short-lived creds if you touch them.
